samples.question: The gray-tagged cluster is the reference. Exactly one colored-tagged cluster places the same four landmark shapes in the same relative layout after rotating the map by 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees. Reflections and swapping shape identities are not allowed; treat each upright symbol as a landmark marker, not an arrow. Which color tags the matching cluster? Answer amber, cyan, or violet.
